title: 种子筛选的调度与判定核心
objective: Advance Task #10's full modern rewrite and source-consistency acceptance in the generation surface through isolated implementation with exact-source differential tests. This is one bounded candidate unit, not a change to the complete task scope.
acceptance: Reference is the unchanged eight-file snapshot at upstream 8d80b5a4dd3d737ed6d3060f05611eaa3de611ab. The following ranges are original HTML lines and must be rechecked against the exact AST before edits: ChineseDungeon.html:66553-66560 初始化随机数生成器; ChineseDungeon.html:66994-67072 开始筛选种子; ChineseDungeon.html:67074-67116 虚拟生成并检查.
Preserve candidate seed order, resets, progress/cancellation/yield behavior and result criteria. Inject virtual generation and UI scheduling; isolated search tests do not prove full game generation.

Expose createSeedSearch(ports) in the new module, returning an object whose callable names and argument order match the selected source functions. Keep mutable world state, factories, time/RNG and UI/service effects explicit in a typed ports interface; preserve aliasing and write-through semantics. Reuse declared reviewed dependencies rather than silently duplicating their candidate algorithms.

Compare the candidate with exact AST-selected original declarations in separate environments. Match input graph aliases while separating candidate/oracle objects; compare fields, relevant identity/prototypes/Map/Symbols, non-finite values, returns/errors, every RNG draw and ordered callbacks. Include source-specific edge cases and demonstrate a meaningful boundary/ordering mutant is detected without changing the tracked reference.

External actors, factories, scheduling, canvas/DOM and network remain explicit typed ports with matching test doubles; production modules never execute original source. Preserve the conditions/arguments/order of UI requests without designing a new interface. This unit proves isolated contracts only; full actor/world/UI/script/save integration stays explicitly pending.

Use only the exact allowed task paths, this turn's protocol-permitted fingerprint/run/result files and STATE. Read shared code, the reference and dependencies without modifying them. Do not edit TASK/DECISIONS/shared rules, weaken compiler/tests, repair source quirks silently, change packet definitions, or introduce live service calls. Report an unforeseen interface or scope need in result.md for primary review.

Record exact coverage, original-vs-candidate or source-only limits, commands/results, detected source quirks and the next action in the packet document and this turn's result.md. Keep the PR Draft for later primary review.
verification: From app, use npm ci --ignore-scripts if dependencies are absent, then npm run typecheck and npm test -- test/seed-search.test.ts. Report actual counts and commands; do not infer results from earlier packets.

Before the completed handoff, run npm run check from app: immutable-reference hashes/integrity tests, strict types, all domain tests and production build. Run only relevant local/offline fixtures; no live service write or unlisted dependency installation.

Inspect the real diff for allowed paths, source-anchor accuracy, concrete superclass/dependency use and production/oracle separation. Preserve meaningful counterexample/trace evidence; document untested UI/browser/whole-game boundaries explicitly.
